      "operation": "add",
      "target": "",

      "fields": {
        "kind": "exception",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "after a material name change"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Governs after an applicant has undergone a material name change.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "(see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names)"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "specifically permits",
        "modality": "not_stated",

proposals.rationale: Adds an exception record qualifying C0003 to capture the explicit exception embedded in 8 FAM 403.1-4(c) that relieves the applicant from the prohibition against continuing to use a previous name when the name change documentation specifically permits continued use.

observations.rationale: The source notes an exception for married names located in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C), but the substantive text of that section is remote and not present in the current focus; the baseline rule C0010 already incorporates the cross-reference.
The parenthetical cross-reference to 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding 'known as' names points to external guidance and is already captured in the references and context quotes of C0003.
